Container.Name: NeedleDrop
Container.Overview: NeedleDrop is a tactile virtual-vinyl client for Navidrome. Selected Discogs/MusicBrainz releases define the physical record, NeedleDrop maps tracks to local playback, NZB Track Repair can fill exact gaps through Newznab/NZBHydra2/Prowlarr plus SABnzbd, and the canonical SQLite collection stores metadata, artwork, merges and repair history.
Container.Requires: A running Navidrome server reachable from this container. NZB Track Repair and Lidarr are optional. Track Repair requires a dedicated SAB completed/staging folder mounted at /repair and a dedicated Navidrome-visible music folder mounted at /music-repair. Advanced verified direct album repair optionally mounts the main music root at /music with write access and remains disabled until explicitly enabled. On normal Unraid media shares use PUID 99, PGID 100 and UMASK 002 unless you intentionally use different ownership.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the NeedleDrop WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent NeedleDrop settings, canonical metadata database, pressing choices and collection-specific metadata.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Initial Navidrome URL. Example: http://192.168.1.100:4533. This can be changed later inside NeedleDrop Settings.

Config.Name: Navidrome Library ID
Config.Description: Optional initial Navidrome library/music-folder ID. Leave blank and select a named library inside NeedleDrop Settings.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Required 64-character random hex secret used to encrypt NeedleDrop sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Discogs Token
Config.Description: Optional initial Discogs personal access token. It can also be entered or replaced inside NeedleDrop Settings.

Config.Name: Last.fm API Key
Config.Description: Optional Last.fm API key for album tags, summaries and popularity metadata. It can also be entered inside NeedleDrop Settings.

Config.Name: NZB Repair Staging
Config.Description: Optional. Mount the dedicated completed folder used by the SABnzbd needledrop-repair category. NeedleDrop only deletes a job folder when its unique repair token matches.

Config.Name: NZB Repair Music Import
Config.Description: Optional. Mount a dedicated folder inside a music tree scanned by Navidrome. NeedleDrop copies only confidently matched requested tracks here first.

Config.Name: Main Music Library for Verified Direct Repair
Config.Description: Advanced optional guardrail-lowering mount. Map the SAME host music root Navidrome scans. NeedleDrop only uses this when Verified Direct Album Repair is explicitly enabled and selected for a repair; the isolated repair copy is created first, strict verification is repeated, and existing files are never overwritten.

Config.Name: NZB Search Provider
Config.Description: Optional Track Repair search provider: newznab, nzbhydra2, or prowlarr. Can also be configured in Library Manager.

Config.Name: NZB Indexer URL
Config.Description: Optional Newznab API endpoint, NZBHydra2 URL/API endpoint, or Prowlarr URL for Track Repair.

Config.Name: NZB Indexer API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for the configured Track Repair search provider. Can also be stored in Library Manager.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL
Config.Description: Optional SABnzbd URL used by NZB Track Repair.

Config.Name: SABnzbd API Key
Config.Description: Optional SABnzbd API key used by NZB Track Repair. Can also be stored in Library Manager.

Config.Name: SAB Repair Category
Config.Description: Dedicated SABnzbd category used for temporary repair downloads.

Config.Name: Verified Direct Repair Default
Config.Description: Advanced. Leave false unless you intentionally want direct writes into existing album folders. This can also be enabled or disabled in Library Manager.

Config.Name: Verified Direct Library Path
Config.Description: Internal container path for the optional main music library direct-repair mount.

Config.Name: Lidarr URL
Config.Description: Optional Lidarr URL used as an album-level fallback for missing tracks. Can also be configured in Library Manager.

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Lidarr API key. Can also be entered in Library Manager.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by NeedleDrop after startup. Unraid default nobody user is UID 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by NeedleDrop after startup. Unraid default users group is GID 100.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for NeedleDrop persistent data.

Config.Name: MusicBrainz User Agent
Config.Description: Initial User-Agent sent to MusicBrainz. Editable inside NeedleDrop Settings.

Config.Name: Settings Admin Users
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated Navidrome usernames allowed to modify system settings or send repair/download requests. Blank allows any authenticated user, suitable for a single-user home install.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal directory used by NeedleDrop for persistent application data.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Use true only when NeedleDrop is accessed over HTTPS. Leave false for plain HTTP over LAN or Tailscale.
